description: Header file defining the AnotherPacketSource class, which implements the MediaSource interface for handling media packets, including buffering, discontinuities, and metadata management within Android's media framework.

classes.name: AnotherPacketSource
classes.description: A class that manages media packet buffers, handles discontinuities, and provides media data to consumers within Android's media framework.

classes.name: DiscontinuitySegment
classes.description: A helper struct representing a segment of media data between discontinuities, tracking maximum dequeue and enqueue times.

methods.name: AnotherPacketSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media packet source with metadata.

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the media format metadata.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the media source processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media source processing.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the current media format.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the next media buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all buffered data.

methods.name: hasBufferAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any buffers, including discontinuities, are available.

methods.name: hasDataBufferAvailable
methods.description: Checks if data buffers (excluding discontinuities) are available.

methods.name: getAvailableBufferCount
methods.description: Returns the count of available buffers.

methods.name: getBufferedDurationUs
methods.description: Returns total buffered duration in microseconds.

methods.name: getEstimatedBufferDurationUs
methods.description: Returns estimated buffer duration based on timestamps.

methods.name: nextBufferTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the next buffer.

methods.name: queueAccessUnit
methods.description: Queues a media access unit (buffer).

methods.name: queueDiscontinuity
methods.description: Queues a discontinuity marker with type, extra info, and discard flag.

methods.name: signalEOS
methods.description: Signals end-of-stream with a result status.

methods.name: dequeueAccessUnit
methods.description: Dequeues a media buffer for processing.

methods.name: requeueAccessUnit
methods.description: Requeues a media buffer.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Checks if the media source has finished processing.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the media source.

methods.name: getLatestEnqueuedMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the latest enqueued buffer.

methods.name: getLatestDequeuedMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the latest dequeued buffer.

methods.name: getMetaAfterLastDequeued
methods.description: Gets metadata after the last dequeued buffer with a delay.

methods.name: trimBuffersAfterMeta
methods.description: Removes buffers after a specified metadata point.

methods.name: trimBuffersBeforeMeta
methods.description: Returns buffers before a specified metadata point.

methods.name: ~AnotherPacketSource
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal buffer state.

methods.name: wasFormatChange
methods.description: Checks if a format change occurred based on discontinuity type.
